column1: # The cases komira refuses by name, each with the refusal it must give, word
# for word: <case> TAB <step>: <reason>, the text sql_result raises (the last
# error komira_sql_stream leaves). A case listed here that komira answers, or
# refuses with other text, is a failure; so is a refused case not listed.

bind: SQL not supported: a CASE with no ELSE whose THEN arms are neither INT64 nor FLOAT64 (a string, a date, a boolean or a narrower integer). The omitted ELSE is a NULL of the arms' type, the typed NULL values this engine's plan can carry are INT64 and FLOAT64 only, and every CASE arm must share one type. Write an explicit ELSE of the same type.

bind: SQL not supported: CAST to VARCHAR from this operand. Number-to-text FORMATTING has not been graded against DuckDB cell for cell (v1.5.3 prints 1e308 as "1e+308", a DECIMAL literal -0.0 as "0.0" but a DOUBLE -0.0 as "-0.0"), and a text column that differs from DuckDB in one cell is a wrong answer with a success code. CAST (not TRY_CAST) to VARCHAR IS served from an INTEGER / BIGINT / VARCHAR operand -- an integer-to-text CAST cannot fail, so for one TRY_CAST is the same answer. A FLOAT or DECIMAL operand can be cast to BIGINT first, which ROUNDS its fraction away (a different text). No remedy is named for a narrower or unsigned integer or a BOOLEAN operand: no cast kernel in column_kernels takes a bit-packed BOOLEAN column, and `eval_cast` there wraps a UINT64 past BIGINT's range where DuckDB raises. A DATE or a TIMESTAMP operand has no remedy at this door: DuckDB refuses CAST(<date> AS BIGINT), and so does this binder.

bind: SQL not supported: a NULL literal is served as a comparison operand (`x = NULL`, `x <> NULL`) and as an IN-list member (`x IN (1, NULL)`, `x NOT IN (1, NULL)`), as a CASE's `ELSE NULL`, as a CASE `THEN NULL` beside INT64 or FLOAT64 arms, and as a COALESCE / IFNULL argument beside a typed one; anywhere else (a projected NULL, `NOT NULL`, `NULL = NULL`, any other function argument, arithmetic, a CASE or COALESCE whose EVERY value is NULL) it needs a typed NULL value this engine's plan does not carry
parse: SQL not supported: SELECT DISTINCT ON (...) (one row per key). Plain SELECT DISTINCT is served.
execute: [Processor] pipeline_exec: MIN (output column 4) over a float column (float64) is served by the ungrouped aggregation sink only; a grouped sink folds signed integers, DECIMAL128 and DATE32

parse: SQL not supported: INTERSECT ALL. The bag form keeps a row min(m, n) (INTERSECT ALL) or max(m - n, 0) (EXCEPT ALL) times, which needs the rows of each side numbered or repeated, and no plan node here does either yet (komira-ai/komira#1229). INTERSECT without ALL, which returns distinct rows, is served.

bind: SQL not supported: the `||` string-concatenation operator. DuckDB's `||` PROPAGATES NULL (`'a' || NULL` is NULL) where this engine's only concatenation, `concat()`, SKIPS a NULL operand (`concat('a', NULL)` is 'a'), and answering one for the other would be wrong on every row with a NULL. The missing primitive is a STRING-typed NULL value in the plan (the CASE that would propagate the NULL has no string NULL to return). `concat(a, b)` is served for the NULL-skipping answer, and is EXACT wherever neither operand can be NULL.
